tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background and sheets. The default ground for all text tokens.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Grouped panels: the progress strip, segmented-control track, search field, empty states.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Presentation only: the backdrop behind phone frames in previews. Never inside the app.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and sections.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Outlines of cards and unselected chips (always paired with a text label, so not the only cue).

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Check-in rings, input and toggle borders. 3.4:1 on bg, 3.1:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, icons and selected chips on bg and surface (17:1).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, descriptions, notes on bg and surface (8:1).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, completed item titles, helper text on bg and surface (5:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent. Check-ins, progress, streaks and the primary button. Text in accent on bg (5.9:1) and accent-tint (5.0:1).

tokens.name: accent-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet accent ground: the highlighted weekly-review card, earned-badge tile, done-state confirmations.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-press fills (5.9:1).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim layer behind bottom sheets.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring around controls; 5.9:1 on bg.

styles.name: t-display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the greeting, the completion headline.

styles.name: t-numeral
styles.usage: Streak counts and completion numbers in the progress strip.

styles.name: t-heading
styles.usage: Section headings, nav bar titles, sheet titles.

styles.name: t-body-strong
styles.usage: Item titles in lists and cards; button labels.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: This opens YouTube. Come back to log it.

styles.name: t-caption
styles.usage: Meta lines under item titles, helper text.

styles.name: t-overline
styles.usage: Group labels (Morning, During the day, Evening) and the date above the greeting. Set in capitals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges, dot gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; title to meta line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label in rows; button groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on a 390px phone.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap above a screen's main title; sheet top padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Breathing room around completion moments.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small tags, day toggles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards, list groups.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (top corners), notification cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, small buttons, check-in rings.

tokens.name: shadow-device
tokens.usage: Presentation only: the phone frame in previews.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets. The only in-app elevation.

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: The selected thumb of a segmented control and toggles.
